fixtures.content:
# X-PLAN

### Batch execution

| Batch | Intent | Depends on | Repo |
|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | x | — | . |
| F2 | x | F1 | . |

### Batch F1 — x — ✅ DONE

### Batch F2 — x — ⬜

cases.name: text mode still prints the next batch
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/X-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/X-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py $d/todo/x/X-PLAN.md | cut -d' ' -f1

cases.name: --next returns the batch of the current repo as JSON and journals its launch
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/X-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/X-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/X-PLAN.md --next $d/j.md | grep -o '"outsideBatch": "F2", "outsidePaths": \[\]' | tr '\n' ';'; cut -d' ' -f1-2 $d/j.md

cases.name: --next lists the out-of-batch paths and journals nothing
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/X-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/X-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; mkdir -p $d/docs; echo y > $d/docs/y.md; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/X-PLAN.md --next $d/j.md | grep -o '"outsidePaths": \["docs/y.md"\]' | tr '\n' ';'; test -e $d/j.md && echo journal || echo no-journal

cases.name: --context gathers earlier audit gaps, user decisions and absent cited paths
cases.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/X-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/X-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; mkdir -p $d/todo/x/run/F1 $d/src/A; printf '## STATUS — DONE

## Audit gaps

- Major — rejected choice X

## End
' > $d/todo/x/run/F1/F1-report.md; printf '
| H1 | user decision: Y |
`src/A/B.cs` `src/A/C.cs` `src/**/*.cs`
' >> $d/todo/x/X-PLAN-F2.md; touch $d/src/A/C.cs; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/X-PLAN.md --context F2 | grep -E '^- Major|user decision|^src/|^cycles' | tr '
' ';'

expect.stdout: - Major — rejected choice X;X-PLAN-F2.md:2: | H1 | user decision: Y |;cycles: none;src/A/B.cs;
